// LOCAL DRIVE ONLY (#4030) — never committed. Drives the «Заявки» screens on
// the local stand: real author intake → admin list/filters → status/notes →
// close with each admin outcome → erase (+ the 409 second erase) → stale 412 →
// non-admin refused → axe + 390px no side scroll.
import { randomUUID } from "node:crypto";
import { expect, test, type Page } from "@playwright/test";
import AxeBuilder from "@axe-core/playwright";
import { signInAsAdmin } from "@ds/e2e/admin-events";
import { signInDoctorOnAdminOrigin } from "./support/storefront-session";

const SHOTS = process.env.DRIVE_SHOTS!;
const CONSENT = process.env.DRIVE_CONSENT!;
const RUN = Date.now().toString(36);
const WCAG = ["wcag2a", "wcag2aa", "wcag21a", "wcag21aa"];

test.describe.configure({ mode: "serial" });

async function shot(page: Page, name: string) {
  await page.screenshot({ path: `${SHOTS}/${name}.png`, fullPage: true });
}

async function axe(page: Page, label: string) {
  const r = await new AxeBuilder({ page }).withTags(WCAG).analyze();
  const v = r.violations.map((x) => `${x.id}: ${x.nodes.map((n) => n.target).join(",")}`);
  expect(v, `axe on ${label}`).toEqual([]);
  console.log(`AXE ${label}: clean`);
}

async function noSideScroll(page: Page, label: string) {
  const over = await page.evaluate(
    () => document.documentElement.scrollWidth - document.documentElement.clientWidth,
  );
  expect(over, `side scroll on ${label}`).toBeLessThanOrEqual(0);
  console.log(`390 ${label}: no side scroll`);
}

async function submitAuthor(page: Page, topic: string): Promise<string> {
  const out = await page.evaluate(
    async ({ topic, consent, key }) => {
      const res = await fetch("/v1/me/applications/author", {
        method: "POST",
        credentials: "include",
        headers: { "content-type": "application/json", "idempotency-key": key },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          topic,
          specialtyOther: "Кардиология",
          format: "course_series",
          about: "Пробная заявка локального прогона",
          consentVersion: consent,
        }),
      });
      return { status: res.status, body: await res.text() };
    },
    { topic, consent: CONSENT, key: randomUUID() },
  );
  expect(out.status, out.body).toBe(201);
  return (JSON.parse(out.body) as { id: string }).id;
}

const ids: Record<string, string> = {};
const topic = (n: number) => `Заявка ${RUN}-${n}`;

test("doctor submits four author applications; a non-admin is refused «Заявки»", async ({
  page,
}) => {
  await page.goto("/login");
  await signInDoctorOnAdminOrigin(page, "applicant");
  const named = await page.evaluate(async () => {
    const r = await fetch("/v1/me/display-name", {
      method: "PUT",
      credentials: "include",
      headers: { "content-type": "application/json" },
      body: JSON.stringify({ displayName: "Анна Прогонова" }),
    });
    return r.status;
  });
  expect([200, 204]).toContain(named);
  for (const n of [1, 2, 3, 4]) ids[n] = await submitAuthor(page, topic(n));

  const api = await page.evaluate(async () => {
    const r = await fetch("/v1/admin/applications", { credentials: "include" });
    return r.status;
  });
  console.log(`NON-ADMIN GET /v1/admin/applications → ${api}`);
  expect([401, 403]).toContain(api);
  await page.goto("/applications");
  await page.waitForTimeout(3000);
  console.log(`NON-ADMIN /applications landed on ${new URL(page.url()).pathname}`);
  await expect(page.getByTestId("applications-table")).toHaveCount(0);
  await shot(page, "01-non-admin-refused");
});

test("admin: list, filters, take into work, note, close «Принята» / «Отклонена», erase + 409, stale 412, axe + 390", async ({
  page,
  browser,
}) => {
  await signInAsAdmin(page);
  await page.getByTestId("nav-applications").click();
  await expect(page).toHaveURL(/\/applications$/);
  const table = page.getByTestId("applications-table");
  await expect(table.getByText(topic(4)).first()).toBeVisible();
  // newest first: 4 above 1
  const text = await table.innerText();
  expect(text.indexOf(topic(4))).toBeLessThan(text.indexOf(topic(1)));
  await expect(page.getByTestId(`application-not-notified-${ids[4]}`).first()).toBeVisible();
  await shot(page, "02-list");
  await axe(page, "list");

  await page.getByTestId("applications-status").selectOption("closed");
  await expect(table.getByText(topic(4))).toHaveCount(0);
  await expect(page.getByText("Статус: Закрытые").first()).toBeVisible();
  await shot(page, "03-filter-closed");
  await page.getByTestId("applications-status").selectOption("new");
  await page.getByTestId("applications-kind").selectOption("author");
  await expect(table.getByText(topic(4)).first()).toBeVisible();
  await shot(page, "04-filter-new-author-chips");

  // 1 — take into work, note, close «Принята»
  await page.goto(`/applications/${ids[1]}`);
  await expect(page.getByTestId("application-heading")).toHaveText(topic(1));
  await expect(page.getByTestId("application-applicant")).toContainText("Анна Прогонова");
  await shot(page, "05-detail-new");
  await axe(page, "detail");
  await page.getByTestId("application-take").click();
  await expect(page.getByTestId("application-status")).toHaveText("На рассмотрении");
  await expect(page.getByTestId("application-take")).toHaveCount(0);
  await page.getByTestId("application-note-submit").click();
  await expect(page.getByTestId("application-note-error")).toBeVisible();
  await page.getByTestId("application-note-input").fill("Созвониться в четверг");
  await page.getByTestId("application-note-submit").click();
  await expect(page.getByTestId("application-notes")).toContainText("Созвониться в четверг");
  await page.getByTestId("application-close").click();
  await expect(page.getByTestId("application-close-submit")).toBeDisabled();
  await page.getByTestId("application-close-dialog").getByText("Принята", { exact: true }).click();
  await expect(page.getByTestId("application-outcome-accepted")).toBeChecked();
  await shot(page, "06-close-dialog");
  await axe(page, "close dialog");
  await page.getByTestId("application-close-submit").click();
  await expect(page.getByTestId("application-status")).toHaveText("Принята");
  await expect(page.getByTestId("application-close")).toHaveCount(0);
  await shot(page, "07-detail-accepted");

  // 2 — close straight from new «Отклонена»
  await page.goto(`/applications/${ids[2]}`);
  await page.getByTestId("application-close").click();
  await page.getByTestId("application-close-dialog").getByText("Отклонена", { exact: true }).click();
  await expect(page.getByTestId("application-outcome-declined")).toBeChecked();
  await page.getByTestId("application-close-submit").click();
  await expect(page.getByTestId("application-status")).toHaveText("Отклонена");

  // 3 — erase; a second tab still showing the button gets 409 ALREADY_ERASED
  const other = await page.context().newPage();
  await other.goto(`/applications/${ids[3]}`);
  await expect(other.getByTestId("application-erase")).toBeVisible();
  await page.goto(`/applications/${ids[3]}`);
  await page.getByTestId("application-erase").click();
  await expect(page.getByTestId("application-erase-kept")).toBeVisible();
  await shot(page, "08-erase-confirm");
  await axe(page, "erase dialog");
  await page.getByTestId("application-erase-submit").click();
  await expect(page.getByTestId("application-erased")).toBeVisible();
  await expect(page.getByTestId("application-applicant-erased")).toBeVisible();
  await expect(page.getByTestId("application-erase")).toHaveCount(0);
  await shot(page, "09-erased");
  await other.getByTestId("application-erase").click();
  await other.getByTestId("application-erase-submit").click();
  await expect(other.getByTestId("application-erase-error")).toContainText(
    "Персональные данные этой заявки уже стёрты.",
  );
  await shot(other, "10-second-erase-409");
  await other.keyboard.press("Escape");

  // 4 — stale 412: tab B read v1, tab A moves it, tab B closes → reload notice
  await other.goto(`/applications/${ids[4]}`);
  await expect(other.getByTestId("application-take")).toBeVisible();
  await page.goto(`/applications/${ids[4]}`);
  await page.getByTestId("application-take").click();
  await expect(page.getByTestId("application-status")).toHaveText("На рассмотрении");
  await other.getByTestId("application-close").click();
  await other.getByTestId("application-close-dialog").getByText("Принята", { exact: true }).click();
  await expect(other.getByTestId("application-outcome-accepted")).toBeChecked();
  await other.getByTestId("application-close-submit").click();
  await expect(other.getByTestId("application-stale")).toBeVisible();
  await expect(other.getByTestId("application-status")).toHaveText("Новая");
  await shot(other, "11-stale-412");
  await other.getByTestId("application-reload").click();
  await expect(other.getByTestId("application-status")).toHaveText("На рассмотрении");
  await other.close();

  // list shows the outcomes and the erased mark
  await page.goto("/applications");
  await expect(page.getByTestId(`application-status-${ids[1]}`).first()).toHaveText("Принята");
  await expect(page.getByTestId(`application-status-${ids[2]}`).first()).toHaveText("Отклонена");
  await expect(page.getByTestId(`application-erased-${ids[3]}`).first()).toBeVisible();
  await shot(page, "12-list-outcomes");
  // cursor pager: more than one page of rows on the branch DB
  await expect(page.getByLabel("Поиск")).toHaveCount(0);
  const readout = page.getByTestId("applications-page").first();
  console.log(`PAGER page 1: ${await readout.innerText()}`);
  await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Вперёд" }).first().click();
  await expect(readout).toHaveText("Страница 2 из 2");
  console.log(`PAGER page 2: ${await readout.innerText()}`);
  await expect(page.getByTestId("applications-table").getByText(topic(4))).toHaveCount(0);
  await shot(page, "12b-list-page-2");
  await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Назад" }).first().click();
  await expect(readout).toContainText("Страница 1");

  // 390 px
  await page.setViewportSize({ width: 390, height: 844 });
  await page.reload();
  await expect(page.getByTestId("applications-table")).toBeVisible();
  await noSideScroll(page, "list");
  await axe(page, "list@390");
  await shot(page, "13-list-390");
  await page.goto(`/applications/${ids[1]}`);
  await expect(page.getByTestId("application-heading")).toBeVisible();
  await noSideScroll(page, "detail");
  await axe(page, "detail@390");
  await shot(page, "14-detail-390");
  void browser;
});
